items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: Where he got Tiny Grimes, boy, I don't know...

ctx.x: Oh yeah. You should have seen him... Did you ever see Art pour a beer? He'd hold the bottle up in front of his eye real close, like this, and he'd take a glass, and he could see it. It was fuzzy, but he could see. He knew what it was at the top. Then he put the bottle down, and he knew right where the straight shot was, and he'd grab that double straight shot, and WHUP, and then go down a beer. Then he'd sit down and rip off "In The Still Of The Night" in five sharps, so fast you couldn't even beat your foot to it.

I was there the first night he heard Slam Stewart. He decided to form his trio. Slam Stewart was the first bass player he had ever played that could talk with him, anticipate him and all that. He said, "Now there is my bass player. I've finally found a bass player. I'm going to form a trio now." Where he got Tiny Grimes, boy, I don't know...
Neither does Tiny. He said, "I don't know why he got me," because Tiny had such a hard time, you know, keeping up with him.
